column3: Issue
Project scaffold: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, ESLint, Prettier, initial AGENTS.md
CI pipeline: lint, type check, unit and integration tests with a Postgres service
Vercel and Neon: preview deployments, environments, production deploy
Security scanning: CodeQL, npm audit, Dependabot
Prisma schema and first migration: users, pets, sessions with lastHeartbeatAt, daily feeding; partial unique index for one active session
Playwright setup and a smoke E2E test in CI
OpenAPI skeleton and Swagger UI route including heartbeat
Signup and login API: bcrypt, JWT in HttpOnly cookie, Zod validation, timezone at signup
Auth screens and protected routes
Default pet Mochi created at signup; rename pet API and settings UI
Reward calculation module: coins, apples, feeding minutes, daily cap, feeding day by timezone
Start session API: one active session, first heartbeat, no completion token
Focus screen: task input, durations, countdown, heartbeats, refresh restore, connection warning
Heartbeat API and presence-deadline resolution (account-owned sessions; 10s heartbeat; 30s grace)
Completion endpoint: presence and end-time checks, exactly-once rewards in a transaction
Result screen showing coins, feeding minutes, and apples earned
Give up: confirmation, abandon API from any tab, slap animation, presence-aware already-ended case
Logout during an active session: confirmation, abandon on all devices
Feeding progress API: pet name, coins, today's apples, feeding minutes, state, daily reset by timezone
Dashboard UI with a distinct pet image or animation for Starving, Hungry, and Full; active session bar
Midnight crossing and late resolution: credit on the scheduled completion day
History API: newest first, 20 per page, ownership checks
History screen: entries, empty state, Load more, end-of-list note
Password reset request: Resend email, hashed single-use tokens, same response for unknown emails, rate limiting
Reset password screen; token version update signs out existing sessions
Full-loop E2E tests: sign up, focus, complete, give up, multi-tab, history
Complete OpenAPI documentation for all endpoints including heartbeat
Architecture and database schema diagrams
README and setup/deployment guide
Accessibility and responsive pass: labels, focus states, contrast, loading/error/empty states
